title: MPG-FER Cumulative Ablation Study Scientific Audit
a5_discrepancy_root_cause: Classification: CASE_2_SAME_NAME_DIFFERENT_SEMANTICS. In Table VI, 'Fixed spatial pooling' meant replacing the learned Spatial Motif Composer of pixels with fixed 12x12 grid pooling, while retaining learnable attention pooling in the motif readout (achieving 70.02% TTA). In Cumulative A5, the Spatial Motif Composer was retained in full multi-scale learned form, while the motif readout pooling was replaced with uniform mean pooling (duplicating m_mean, achieving 64.59% TTA). The two models evaluate different hypotheses and should not produce the same metric.
old_dense_motif_equivalence: Table VI DENSE_MOTIF is an exact 100% semantic and structural match for candidate P4 (+ Learnable Motif Readout with dense relations). It has multi-scale composition, geometry bias, dense 5-layer Motif GNN, and learnable attention readout. It achieved 70.33% TTA.

recommended_paper_ladder.added_module: Baseline (Pixel GNN + Pixel Readout only; zero motif vector)
Single-scale 12x12 Spatial Motif Composer (bypasses Motif GNN, fixed readout pooling)
5-layer Motif GNN with relative geometry bias (dense relations, fixed readout pooling)
Multi-scale 8/12/16 composition with learned scale gating (dense relations, fixed readout pooling)
Learnable attention pooling in motif readout (dense relations, multi-scale, geometry bias)
Dynamic Top-K relations schedule [8, 16, 16, 16, 24] (canonical FULL MPG-FER v2.3)
